display.purpose: Page title and primary section hierarchy.

shadows.purpose: Separate the focused record dialog from the live table.

motion.name: panel-arrive
motion.purpose: Reveal the inline consolidation panel once.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Keep button hover and focus state changes responsive.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority action for creating or calculating.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #e85c32; color: #fff; font: 650 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #ca4927; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #146fc1; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-priority action that remains distinct from the main workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #d3dae0; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #172635; font: 650 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #b6c1ca; background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #146fc1; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Record Quantity Control
components.description: Quantity controls keep the original magenta and orange project colors.
components.css: .ds-record-control { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #da1884; border-radius: 5px; background: #da1884; color: #fff; font: 650 12px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-record-control:hover { border-color: #ff671f; background: #ff671f; color: #172635; } .ds-record-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #146fc1; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Editable Status
components.description: Amber badge pairs a state label with a status dot.
components.css: .ds-status-editable { display: inline-flex; min-height: 25px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 20px; background: #fff4dc; color: #926016; font: 650 11px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-status-editable span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Generated Status
components.description: Green badge pairs a generated-state label with a status dot.
components.css: .ds-status-generated { display: inline-flex; min-height: 25px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 20px; background: #e9f5ef; color: #237b57; font: 650 11px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-status-generated span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Date Input
components.description: Accessible date field for inclusive consolidation ranges.
components.css: .ds-date-field { display: grid; min-width: 190px; gap: 7px; color: #445464; font: 650 12px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-date-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #cbd4db; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #172635; font: 400 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-date-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #146fc1; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: La interfaz convierte el trabajo repetido de registrar y revisar cantidades en un tablero operativo claro. Su tono es directo y profesional: cada estado se identifica con texto además de color, las acciones quedan junto al registro y los datos mantienen suficiente espacio para leerse de un vistazo. La identidad vive en una navegación azul carbón y un acento naranja reservado para la acción principal; los controles del registro mantienen el magenta y el naranja originales. El gris frío de fondo mantiene el foco en el trabajo.
keyCharacteristics: Densidad de tabla legible, con controles próximos al registro.
Acento naranja para acciones primarias; estados con colores semánticos.
Navegación oscura y superficies claras para separar orientación y contenido.

rules.name: La Regla de Estado Explícito
rules.body: El estado de un registro siempre conserva su etiqueta textual; el color solo la refuerza.

rules.name: La Regla del Control Original
rules.body: Los botones del detalle conservan magenta #da1884 y hover naranja #ff671f.

dos: Do keep editable and generated labels visible alongside their status colors.
Do preserve date fields, keyboard focus rings, and mobile row actions.
donts: Don't hide row actions behind horizontal scrolling on narrow screens.
Don't replace the records table with decorative metric cards.
